Columbia Seligman Premium Technology Growth Func Inc ( (STK) ) has issued an update.

On August 7, 2026, Columbia Seligman Premium Technology Growth Fund, Inc. declared a third-quarter distribution of $0.4625 per share under its managed distribution policy, to be paid on August 25, 2026 to shareholders of record as of August 17, 2026. The payout equates to a 2.3125% quarterly rate, or 9.25% annualized, on the original $20.00 IPO price from November 2009, and represents a 0.9421% quarterly rate, or 3.77% annualized, based on the July 31, 2026 market price of $49.09.

The fund reported that this distribution, and all 2026 year-to-date distributions through the August payment date, are estimated to be sourced entirely from net realized long-term capital gains, with no return of capital so far this year. Management highlighted that the fund’s 5-year average annual total NAV return through July 31, 2026 was 21.35%, and its year-to-date cumulative total NAV return at that date was 43.31%, while stressing that distribution levels should not be viewed as an indication of future performance and may be adjusted by the board.
